description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE April 19, 2026 Contact: press@joannamendoza.com TUCSON, AZ – Today, JoAnna Mendoza, retired Marine, working mom, and Democratic Candidate for Arizona’s Sixth Congressional District, joined supporters and members of the community to officially open her first campaign office in Pima County. “If you all weren’t patriots, you would not be here with us […]
